packages.scripts:
preinstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ 'none' = pre ]; then
    echo 'injected pre-install failure' >&2
    exit 1
fi
postinstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
touch /etc/shells
for shell in /usr/bin/wsh /bin/wsh; do
    grep -qxF "$shell" /etc/shells || echo "$shell" >> /etc/shells
done
if [ 'none' = post ]; then
    echo 'injected post-install failure' >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ 'none' = pause ]; then
    touch /run/wsh-rpm-post-paused
    sleep 120
fi
exit 0
preuninstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ "$1" = 0 ] && awk -F: '$7 == "/usr/bin/wsh" || $7 == "/bin/wsh" { found = 1 } END { exit !found }' /etc/passwd; then
    echo 'Wsh is still a local account shell. Change those accounts to another installed shell before removal.' >&2
    exit 1
fi
exit 0
postuninstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ "$1" = 0 ] && [ -f /etc/shells ]; then
    sed -i '\!^/usr/bin/wsh$!d; \!^/bin/wsh$!d' /etc/shells
fi
exit 0

packages.scripts:
preinstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ 'none' = pre ]; then
    echo 'injected pre-install failure' >&2
    exit 1
fi
postinstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
touch /etc/shells
for shell in /usr/bin/wsh /bin/wsh; do
    grep -qxF "$shell" /etc/shells || echo "$shell" >> /etc/shells
done
if [ 'none' = post ]; then
    echo 'injected post-install failure' >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ 'none' = pause ]; then
    touch /run/wsh-rpm-post-paused
    sleep 120
fi
exit 0
preuninstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ "$1" = 0 ] && awk -F: '$7 == "/usr/bin/wsh" || $7 == "/bin/wsh" { found = 1 } END { exit !found }' /etc/passwd; then
    echo 'Wsh is still a local account shell. Change those accounts to another installed shell before removal.' >&2
    exit 1
fi
exit 0
postuninstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ "$1" = 0 ] && [ -f /etc/shells ]; then
    sed -i '\!^/usr/bin/wsh$!d; \!^/bin/wsh$!d' /etc/shells
fi
exit 0

packages.scripts:
preinstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ 'pre' = pre ]; then
    echo 'injected pre-install failure' >&2
    exit 1
fi
postinstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
touch /etc/shells
for shell in /usr/bin/wsh /bin/wsh; do
    grep -qxF "$shell" /etc/shells || echo "$shell" >> /etc/shells
done
if [ 'pre' = post ]; then
    echo 'injected post-install failure' >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ 'pre' = pause ]; then
    touch /run/wsh-rpm-post-paused
    sleep 120
fi
exit 0
preuninstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ "$1" = 0 ] && awk -F: '$7 == "/usr/bin/wsh" || $7 == "/bin/wsh" { found = 1 } END { exit !found }' /etc/passwd; then
    echo 'Wsh is still a local account shell. Change those accounts to another installed shell before removal.' >&2
    exit 1
fi
exit 0
postuninstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ "$1" = 0 ] && [ -f /etc/shells ]; then
    sed -i '\!^/usr/bin/wsh$!d; \!^/bin/wsh$!d' /etc/shells
fi
exit 0

packages.scripts:
preinstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ 'post' = pre ]; then
    echo 'injected pre-install failure' >&2
    exit 1
fi
postinstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
touch /etc/shells
for shell in /usr/bin/wsh /bin/wsh; do
    grep -qxF "$shell" /etc/shells || echo "$shell" >> /etc/shells
done
if [ 'post' = post ]; then
    echo 'injected post-install failure' >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ 'post' = pause ]; then
    touch /run/wsh-rpm-post-paused
    sleep 120
fi
exit 0
preuninstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ "$1" = 0 ] && awk -F: '$7 == "/usr/bin/wsh" || $7 == "/bin/wsh" { found = 1 } END { exit !found }' /etc/passwd; then
    echo 'Wsh is still a local account shell. Change those accounts to another installed shell before removal.' >&2
    exit 1
fi
exit 0
postuninstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ "$1" = 0 ] && [ -f /etc/shells ]; then
    sed -i '\!^/usr/bin/wsh$!d; \!^/bin/wsh$!d' /etc/shells
fi
exit 0

packages.scripts:
preinstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ 'pause' = pre ]; then
    echo 'injected pre-install failure' >&2
    exit 1
fi
postinstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
touch /etc/shells
for shell in /usr/bin/wsh /bin/wsh; do
    grep -qxF "$shell" /etc/shells || echo "$shell" >> /etc/shells
done
if [ 'pause' = post ]; then
    echo 'injected post-install failure' >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ 'pause' = pause ]; then
    touch /run/wsh-rpm-post-paused
    sleep 120
fi
exit 0
preuninstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ "$1" = 0 ] && awk -F: '$7 == "/usr/bin/wsh" || $7 == "/bin/wsh" { found = 1 } END { exit !found }' /etc/passwd; then
    echo 'Wsh is still a local account shell. Change those accounts to another installed shell before removal.' >&2
    exit 1
fi
exit 0
postuninstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ "$1" = 0 ] && [ -f /etc/shells ]; then
    sed -i '\!^/usr/bin/wsh$!d; \!^/bin/wsh$!d' /etc/shells
fi
exit 0
